business_problem: Softinstigate needed a simpler architecture than its mix of relational databases and heavy application servers so it could build cloud-native products, move faster for Italian SMB customers, and stop spending engineering time on server and database upkeep.
solution_summary: Softinstigate centered its product architecture on MongoDB and AWS by building RESTHeart, a stateless REST API microservice that exposes MongoDB through simple HTTP calls. MongoDB Atlas became the managed document database for most of the company's products and deployments, while RESTHeart handles request routing and lets customers map JSON payloads directly into the database without writing server-side glue code. The design models sessions and transactions as first-class REST resources and benefits from MongoDB's atomic document operations plus multi-document transaction support. Because failover, scaling, and upgrades are easier on Atlas than on the company's former relational stack, Softinstigate can focus on rapidly delivering cloud-native applications, microservices, and customer MVPs instead of hand-managing infrastructure. The same pattern underpins customer solutions such as automotive marketplaces, traffic-data connectors, digital voting systems, and IoT agriculture projects.

solution_components.name: RESTHeart
solution_components.role: Provides the stateless REST API layer that exposes MongoDB data and transactions over HTTP without custom server-side code.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Runs the managed document database for Softinstigate's products and customer deployments on AWS.

data_flow: Web and mobile clients send HTTP requests to RESTHeart, which uses MongoDB drivers to read and write documents and transactions in MongoDB Atlas, then returns JSON responses that power customer applications and APIs.
business_outcome: Softinstigate achieved five-nines-style reliability on MongoDB, cut backend development time dramatically for customer projects, and turned RESTHeart into a broadly adopted product with nearly one million downloads.
metrics: Users have downloaded RESTHeart nearly one million times.
AutoInRete.com needed only 11 developer days to build the backend with RESTHeart and MongoDB after a 215 developer-day MVP.
architecture_clues: RESTHeart is written in Java and embeds the Undertow HTTP server.
Softinstigate models sessions and transactions as first-class REST resources.
The architecture commonly runs Kubernetes clusters against MongoDB.
Most products and services are deployed on MongoDB Atlas running on AWS.
